workItem: Create one bounded Enterprise workflow-permissions writer that can only change GitHub Actions PR-review approval from true to false while preserving default workflow permissions=read.
workItemDE: Einen strikt begrenzten Enterprise-Workflow-Permissions-Writer erstellen, der ausschließlich GitHub-Actions-PR-Review-Approval von true auf false setzt und default workflow permissions=read unverändert erhält.
priorityReason: Run #35999363977 proved Enterprise workflow permissions are readable and currently expose canApprovePullRequestReviews=true while the Human Owner explicitly requested a bounded admin-token writer.
scopeBoundary: Desired state is hard-coded to default_workflow_permissions=read and can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false.
Writer must fail closed if pre-read default_workflow_permissions is not read.
No selected-actions, Actions enablement, SHA-pinning, organization, repository, billing, IAM, secret, ruleset, deployment or other provider setting may be mutated.
No generic raw REST proxy or user-supplied endpoint/value is permitted.
The already-provisioned Organization secret CAPITAL_AI_GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_READ_PAT may be injected only into this bounded workflow and must never be logged or persisted.
exitEvidence: Pre-read observes default_workflow_permissions=read before any mutation.
Already-hardened read/false state is an idempotent NOOP.
read/true state produces exactly one PUT with the fixed desired body.
Unit tests prove fail-closed behavior and token non-disclosure.
Workflow is main-only, owner-only, workflow_dispatch-only and requires an exact confirmation phrase.
Human/CODEOWNER merge remains mandatory before provider mutation capability can exist on main.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
